Product.RichDescription:
Stage 2 - From 6 - 12 months800gmOli6 Goat Milk Follow On Formula is a premium goat milk infant formula.

Introducing Oli6. One of the leading brands in goat milk infant formula nutrition. May be suitable for children with allergies, and sensitivities.
Made from 100% Goat Milk. Manufactured in Australia, adhering to the strict Australian regulatory guidelines.

Oli6 Stage 2 Follow On Formula provides full nutrition to assist with growth and development for children between the ages of 6-12 months.Breastfeeding is the best and most suitable for your baby. If you do not breastfeed, Oli6 provides an alternative and is suitable from birth. Before you decide to use Oli6, consult your healthcare professional for advice.It is recommended that children should be offered foods in addition to infant formula from 6 months.As at 12 months, Oli6 Stage 2 Follow On Formula, can be replaced by Oli6 Stage 3 Toddler Drink.

Oli6 is a leading scientifically researched formulation with a blend of prebiotics, probiotics, oligos, vitamins A, B, C, Zinc and DHA and 2'-FL

The natural prebiotics found in Oli6 naturally aid gut health and digestion.

Oli6 Stage 2 (6-12 months)

Oli6 is made from high quality goat milk that is naturally easier to digest.

Oli6 contains natural prebiotics oligosaccharides. There are up to six times the amount of natural prebiotic oligos in goats milk when compared to cows milk.

Contains Zinc and Vitamin C

Zinc and Vitamin C to aid brain development and cognitive function

AdditionalAttributes.ingredients: Lactose, goat milk solids (full cream milk powder,whey protein powder), vegetable oils (including soybean), DHA powder, ARA powder, minerals (calciumcarbonate, sodium citrate, ferric pyrophosphate,sodium selenite, zinc oxide, copper gluconate, manganese sulphate, potassium iodide), oligosaccharides (2'-O-fucosyllactose, lacto-N-neotetraose), choline bitartrate, vitamins (C, E, A, D3, B5, B3, K1, B2, B1, B12, B6, B9, B7), L-methionine, Bifidobacterium longum (BB536), taurine, inositol, L-carnitine, lutein.
AdditionalAttributes.storageinstructions: If the bottle is to be stored prior to use it must be kept refrigerated and used within 24 hours.

TgaAttributes.ProductWarnings:
Follow On Formula suitable for infants from 6 months of age. This product should not be used for infants under 6 months of age. It is recommended that infants from the age of 6 months should be offered foods in addition to the infant formula product.
Important Notice – Breast milk is best for babies. Before you decide to use this product consult your doctor or health worker for advice.
Warning – follow instructions exactly. Prepare bottles and teats as directed. Do not change proportions or concentrate except on medical advice. Incorrect preparation can make your baby very ill.
TgaAttributes.StorageInstructions: If the bottle is to be stored prior to use it must be kept refrigerated and used within 24 hours.
